function.arguments:
{"script": "python3 << 'EOF'
import FreeCAD
import Part
import Sketcher

# Create a new document
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("Unnamed")

# Create a sketch object
sketch = doc.addObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "Sketch")

# Define rectangle corners (lower-left at 40,0; width 10, height 6)
# Corners: (40,0), (50,0), (50,6), (40,6)

# Add the rectangle as separate edges to the sketch
# Edge 1: (40,0) to (50,0) - bottom
edge1 = Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(40, 0, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(50, 0, 0))
# Edge 2: (50,0) to (50,6) - right
edge2 = Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(50, 0, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(50, 6, 0))
# Edge 3: (50,6) to (40,6) - top
edge3 = Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(50, 6, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(40, 6, 0))
# Edge 4: (40,6) to (40,0) - left
edge4 = Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(40, 6, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(40, 0, 0))

# Add geometry to sketch
geo_idx_1 = sketch.addGeometry(edge1, False)
geo_idx_2 = sketch.addGeometry(edge2, False)
geo_idx_3 = sketch.addGeometry(edge3, False)
geo_idx_4 = sketch.addGeometry(edge4, False)

print(f"Added rectangle edges: {geo_idx_1}, {geo_idx_2}, {geo_idx_3}, {geo_idx_4}")

# Now add the horizontal line from upper-right corner (50,6) with length 12
# Line from (50,6) to (62,6)
line_edge = Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(50, 6, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(62, 6, 0))
geo_idx_line = sketch.addGeometry(line_edge, False)
print(f"Added line edge: {geo_idx_line}")

# Add constraints to make it a closed block (rectangle)
# We need coincident constraints between endpoints

# Coincident: edge1 end == edge2 start (at 50,0)
# In Sketcher, we reference vertices by (geometry_index, vertex_position)
# For a line segment: vertex 1 is start, vertex 2 is end

# Edge1: (40,0) -> (50,0): vertex 1=start, vertex 2=end
# Edge2: (50,0) -> (50,6): vertex 1=start, vertex 2=end
# Edge3: (50,6) -> (40,6): vertex 1=start, vertex 2=end  
# Edge4: (40,6) -> (40,0): vertex 1=start, vertex 2=end

# Connect edge1 end to edge2 start
sketch.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Coincident', geo_idx_1, 2, geo_idx_2, 1))
# Connect edge2 end to edge3 start
sketch.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Coincident', geo_idx_2, 2, geo_idx_3, 1))
# Connect edge3 end to edge4 start
sketch.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Coincident', geo_idx_3, 2, geo_idx_4, 1))
# Connect edge4 end to edge1 start
sketch.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Coincident', geo_idx_4, 2, geo_idx_1, 1))

# Connect the line to the rectangle at upper-right corner (50,6)
# This is where edge2 ends and edge3 starts
# Line starts at (50,6), so connect line start (vertex 1) to edge2 end (vertex 2) or edge3 start (vertex 1)
sketch.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Coincident', geo_idx_line, 1, geo_idx_2, 2))

print("Constraints added for closed rectangle and line connection")

# Save the document
doc.saveAs("/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")
print("Document saved to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")

# Verify
FreeCAD.closeDocument("Unnamed")
doc2 = FreeCAD.open("/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")
print("Document reopened successfully")
for obj in doc2.Objects:
    print(f"  Object: {obj.Name}, Type: {obj.TypeId}")
    
print("\nDone!")
EOF"}
